skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create polished frontend pages, components, and applications with strong visual direction and production-quality implementation guidance.
skill.summary: Guides distinctive, production-ready frontend design and implementation.
skill.author: am-will

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces weaken product clarity and trust. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create polished frontend pages with intentional visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of web components, pages, applications, and interfaces.
Prompts a clear aesthetic direction before implementation begins.
Supports production-grade HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or similar frontend code.
Provides guidance for typography, color, motion, layout, backgrounds, and visual details.
Discourages generic layouts, overused fonts, predictable palettes, and repeated visual patterns.
limitations: It provides design and implementation guidance, not a full design system audit.
It does not include bundled assets, templates, fonts, or component libraries.
It depends on the host agent for code generation, testing, and file editing.
It may require user constraints for accessibility, framework, and performance targets.

use_cases.title: Product Interface Refresh
use_cases.description: Redesign an existing dashboard or workflow with a stronger visual direction and refined interaction details.

use_cases.title: Prototype A New Web App
use_cases.description: Create a working frontend concept that balances implementation quality with a distinctive product identity.

use_cases.title: Improve Component Polish
use_cases.description: Upgrade a component with better typography, spacing, color, motion, and layout choices.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Landing Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a polished landing section for my product. Use a distinctive visual direction and include responsive layout details.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Product Dashboard
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a full interface.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a product dashboard for this audience and workflow. Choose a clear aesthetic direction, then implement the main screen.

prompt_templates.title: Refine An Existing Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this component visually without changing its purpose. Focus on typography, spacing, color, motion, and interaction states.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Complete Visual System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for broader frontend direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement a cohesive frontend experience for this app. Define the visual direction, key screens, states, and responsive behavior.

output_examples.input: A finance dashboard needs a less generic interface.
output_examples.output: A refined dashboard concept with clearer hierarchy, sharper typography, restrained motion, and purposeful data density.

output_examples.input: A portfolio homepage should feel memorable and premium.
output_examples.output: A distinctive homepage direction with strong composition, curated type choices, polished sections, and responsive interaction details.

output_examples.input: A settings panel feels plain and unfinished.
output_examples.output: A more complete settings interface with improved spacing, grouped controls, clearer states, and subtle visual depth.

best_practices: Provide the product context, target audience, framework, and required screens before generation.
State accessibility, responsive behavior, and performance constraints early.
Ask for a clear visual direction before requesting detailed implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic modern interface without context or audience details.
Do not accept repeated font, color, and layout choices across unrelated projects.
Do not prioritize decorative effects over usability, hierarchy, and responsive behavior.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create frontend components, pages, applications, and interfaces with stronger visual design quality.

faq.question: Does it generate working code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to implement working frontend code when the user requests it.

faq.question: Which frameworks can it support?
faq.answer: It can guide HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend implementation work.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made templates?
faq.answer: No. It guides custom design decisions instead of shipping fixed templates or bundled assets.

faq.question: Is it useful for redesigning existing UI?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help refine typography, layout, color, motion, backgrounds, and component details.

faq.question: Can it replace accessibility testing?
faq.answer: No. It can include accessibility constraints, but dedicated testing is still required.
